excerpts.author: ethdreamer
excerpts.content:
Okay i now disagree with this idea..
The execution engine does not use the same nomenclature for the fork as the consensus side. It would be just as ugly to pick one and have one of the clients map between them as it would be to have both of them calculate the fork
